title: Art round 6: only what you asked

cards.title: Exactly your notes
cards.text: Each design changed only where your note said, shown beside the version you saw.
cards.why: Tick the ones that are right now. Each 'before' tile is the last version, for comparing.
cards.details:
Every design was rebuilt from the exact file you saw, and only the note was applied. Where last round had redrawn something instead of doing your note (the lizards, dragonborn, goblin, imp, devil), it went back to the earlier version with only your note applied. All of it was done by Opus at the highest effort.

Heroes not picked with no note (Bearskin, Necromancer, Pyromancer, Storm, Beekeeper, Lantern keeper, Plague doctor, Templar, Scarecrow, Vampire, the tamers) were left alone: they need a note each to know what to fix.

items.label: Witch
items.text: Witch (caster-witch.svg), picked. "Remove shine. Make tip of hat a slightly less weird shape": the pale shine on the crown is gone; the tip is one smooth bent cone tapering evenly to a rounded point (it ended in a thin hooked flick). Nothing else changed.

items.label: Witch (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Chef
items.text: Chef (support-chef.svg). "Hat bad": a new hat only. A toque seen from above: a broad band wrapping the top of the head down to the brow, and a big puffed top as wide as the head (round 5: a narrow band and a small puff on the back of the head, bare scalp between). Face, moustache, jacket, pan and spoon as they were.

items.label: Chef (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Seer
items.text: Seer (support-seer.svg), picked. "Eyeband doesn't look right. Should be u see hair and flipped": the blindfold now bows down round the front of the face (it arched upward, so it read upside down) and sits under the hair: the fringe comes down onto its top edge and the two front locks lie over its ends, so hair shows above and beside it. Same band colour and width, same hair.

items.label: Seer (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Harpooner
items.text: Harpooner (ranged-harpooner.svg), picked. "Where beard go?": the round-4 grey beard is back (same scalloped shape, size, place and colour), drawn over the face, without the mouth line on it that read as a nose; the round-5 moustache sits on it. Its two top lobes are left off so no grey pokes up between the moustache and the hat.

items.label: Harpooner (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Marksman A
items.text: Marksman A (ranged-marksman-a.svg), picked. "Gun too short. Give facial hair. Maybe skinny grey moustache": the same musket, about a fifth longer (the stock reaches further back along the shoulder, the barrel further forward, the wooden fore-stock ends at the front hand so more steel barrel shows; the hands stay put); a thin grey moustache with flicked-up ends, on the face over the mouth.

items.label: Marksman A (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Ninja
items.text: Ninja (ranged-ninja.svg), picked. "Make mask softer/ less sharp turn": the mask still rises over the nose, in one soft round curve instead of a point; its fold line follows it.

items.label: Ninja (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Pirate
items.text: Pirate (ranged-pirate.svg), picked. "Wider bowl of hat. Wider hat overall": the tricorn 18% wider (same height, same gold edge); its crown (the bowl) from a 48-wide circle to a 68 x 52 oval.

items.label: Pirate (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Slinger
items.text: Slinger (ranged-slinger.svg), picked. "Needs fixing of hat but looks interesting": the same ram-fleece hood and horns, cleaned up: the darker crescent across the brow (it read as a frowning visor) is gone, so the hood ends in its own woolly edge; no shine or spots on the wool; the horns go under the hood so their roots tuck into the wool; no scratch lines on the horns.

items.label: Slinger (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Trapper
items.text: Trapper (ranged-trapper.svg, and ranged-trapper-right.svg), picked. "Why hat not on right?": the cap sat turned 9 degrees on the head and looked knocked askew; it now sits straight and centred. In case the note meant the tilt should go the other way, -right has the same slight tilt mirrored (crown leaning right). Same cap otherwise.

items.label: Trapper (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Executioner
items.text: Executioner (fighter-executioner.svg), no note: the same fault as the werewolf's human form (a flat stubble crescent hanging past the chin, read as a shadow behind the head). Now a short dark beard on the jaw, drawn over the face. Nothing else changed.

items.label: Executioner (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Gladiator
items.text: Gladiator (fighter-gladiator.svg), picked. "Give a spartan styled helmet": a Corinthian helm: one bronze shell over the head with cheek guards down to the jaw, the face showing through a T (an eye band split by a nose guard, a slot to the chin where the mouth shows); the round-5 red crest front to back, now ending at the brow. Body, gladius and shield as they were.

items.label: Gladiator (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Werewolf human
items.text: Werewolf human (fighter-werewolf-human.svg), picked. "Facial hair layered wrong... Remove sheen from hair and the lines. Flip axe": the stubble was a see-through crescent hanging below the chin, so it read as a shadow behind the head; it is now a short scruffy beard in the hair's colour, drawn on the face from the sideburns round the jaw, the mouth above it. The hair has no sheen patch and no lines. The hatchet head is mirrored across the haft (the blade faces in, toward the body).

items.label: Werewolf human (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Werewolf
items.text: Werewolf (fighter-werewolf.svg), picked. "Weird fangs. Weird shadowing in some places, like that top head segment and ears": no light sheen patches (skull, ruff, paws) and no dark stripes on the skull; the skull's shadow on the ruff is short and soft (it ringed the top of the head like a separate dome); the inner ears follow the ear's shape in a muted pink (they were round pink spots); two curved fangs hang from the upper jaw beside the nose (they were flat triangles on the snout's sides).

items.label: Werewolf (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Bat
items.text: Bat (bat.svg), picked. "Decent. Fix shading. Maybe add nose": the face used the heroes' face gradient (dark at the top, as under a hat brim the bat doesn't have), which put a dark band across the head; it is lit like the rest of the bat now, light top left to darker bottom right. A small dark nose on the snout.

items.label: Bat (before)
items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.label: Angel B
items.text: Angel B (celestial-angel-b.svg). "Halo is behind, not layered properly": the same thin pale halo is drawn over the head now, floating: its near arc crosses the top of the hair, its far arc is beyond the head, with a faint shadow on the hair under it.

items.text: The version you saw last round, for comparison.

items.text: Snowman (snowman.svg). "Stack the head over the body in the middle": the head is centred exactly on the body (both balls on the sprite's centre), so it stands straight under the camera; the scarf ring, beanie, coal smile and carrot moved up with the head. Same shapes and colours.
